gate.sellerDescription: a UK flow-control supplier that sells sanitary process valves into pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing, through the manufacturers and the contractors who build their facilities
gate.subjectTest: is the thing being built, financed or contracted a pharmaceutical, biotech or life-sciences manufacturing or processing facility? That means a production plant, an API or drug substance plant, a bioprocessing or fermentation facility, a sterile or aseptic production suite, a fill-finish line, a GMP cleanroom, or a campus of these. A hospital, clinic, care home, retail pharmacy, university or teaching building, a pure research or discovery laboratory with no manufacturing, an office, a warehouse or distribution or logistics centre, a data centre, and any other non manufacturing construction all fail here and are rejected even when the headline is a real construction or contract win and even when a pharmaceutical company is the client. If the subject is not a pharmaceutical, biotech or life-sciences manufacturing or processing facility, dcRelevant is false. On a construction, contract or job headline the subject must be recognisably a manufacturing or processing facility to pass; if you cannot confirm that from the text, including an unfamiliar or abbreviated term, default to reject rather than pass on the strength of the event or the client's name.
gate.eventTest: is this a real build event, the facility being built, contracted, or financed, invested in or expanded as a specific facility or campus? KEEP financing, investment, funding or expansion that attaches to an actual facility or campus, for example a manufacturer funding a new production plant or expanding a existing site's capacity. REJECT everything that is not a build of a facility, however important it is to the company: a drug approval, a regulatory decision or submission, clinical trial results or a trial start, a product launch, a licensing, supply or distribution agreement, a merger, acquisition, divestment or partnership, company financial results, funding raised for research or a drug programme rather than for a named facility, a patent or litigation matter, a leadership or staffing change, a plant closure or job losses, an opposition or community meeting, a moratorium or objection, a survey, report, opinion or comment piece, and generic sector, market or policy commentary. Equipment or component supply to a manufacturer, for example bioreactors or isolators, is a supplier's commercial news, not the facility being built, and is rejected. The test for the event is whether the money or expansion attaches to an actual facility or campus: if it does, keep; if it is corporate, clinical, regulatory or commercial news, reject.

positioning.campaignPhrase: the pharmaceutical and biotech process campaign
positioning.profileFitLine: lead with why Steriflow sanitary process valves are relevant to hygienic and sterile process specification on pharmaceutical and biotech production, and a light reason a person in the contact's role might care. Be specific to the work, do not say they fit a profile.
positioning.rangeLine: PCT supplies the Steriflow sanitary valve range, built for hygienic and sterile process duty: 316L barstock construction, FDA and USP Class VI materials, Jorlon diaphragms, CIP and SIP capability, self-draining ASME BPE design, and Unicert traceability documentation.
positioning.trustLine: Steriflow valves are widely used across pharmaceutical and biotech production.
positioning.trustLinePrefix: Track record, state in general form and with confidence:
positioning.confidentialityHardLimit: Hard limit: never name or imply a specific pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturer or end customer. "Widely used across pharmaceutical and biotech production" is the ceiling of specificity.
positioning.positioningRule: Position the Steriflow sanitary valve range as built for and trusted in hygienic and sterile process duty.
positioning.trackRecordRule: you may state, confidently and in general form, that Steriflow valves are widely used across pharmaceutical and biotech production. CONFIDENTIALITY RULE, absolute: never name or imply any specific pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturer or end customer. 'Widely used across pharmaceutical and biotech production' is the ceiling of specificity. No 'a major vaccine manufacturer', no 'a well-known biotech', no named manufacturer, nothing that points to a specific customer.
positioning.confidentialityRule: CONFIDENTIALITY RULE, absolute: never name or imply any specific pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturer or end customer. 'Widely used across pharmaceutical and biotech production' is the ceiling of specificity.
positioning.structurePositioning: one line positioning the Steriflow sanitary valve range as built for hygienic and sterile process duty, including the general track record across pharmaceutical and biotech production, with no named customer and no part-specific spec
